method_note: Links are by sample-ID string match only (exact, or after stripping the documented PLINK FID_IID doubling artefact). This is reliable WITHIN the array ID namespace, where all batches inherit the same lab sample IDs. It does NOT attempt cross-technology identity (array vs exome/genome), which cannot be established from IDs alone - those cohorts use unrelated ID schemes (sample01..16, CardioN) and would require genotype concordance.
